features.note: Rack ears read as brighter zinc metal against the matte charcoal body; the top face catches the environment. No regression.

ASK 1 delivered. The LCD now reads as GLASS: a sharp room reflection gradients across the panel (lighter at top, fading to near-black), which is what makes an OFF screen read as glass — not refraction. lcd_glass envMapIntensity 1.0 -> 2.20, roughness held at the spec's 0.05. Transmission was correctly NOT used (MeshPhysicalMaterial.transmission stalls SwiftShader shader compile -> 0-draw probe), and it is not what sells a dark screen anyway. Reads as a recessed glass display now, not a flat black rectangle.
Button reads as a collared control; 4 LEDs green in the default (power on). No regression.

ASK 2 delivered, and MEASURED honestly. vent_cavity envMapIntensity 1.0 -> 0.28 (a throat is an occluded cavity; full room light there flattens the recess back toward a darker bar — the very defect structural just removed). The contrast that makes the vents read is NOT throat-vs-bezel (both near-black on this chassis, luma 0.004 vs 0.006, no albedo choice separates them) but the louvre BLADE catching light while the throat stays dark: 0.0124 vs 0.0010 reflected-environment, 12.1x, and asserted so a later pass cannot silently close that gap. The side-vent grid reads on the flank.

important_features.note: Deep body read reinforced by the side-vent grid. No regression.

defects: OPEN ITEM (not a defect): rear receptacle layout still unbuilt (no P1 source for count/type).
OPEN ITEM: the display is glass but DARK in every state — lighting it is a surface concern needing screen content, and that content cannot fabricate readings. Correct discipline.
Front-grille recesses still read subtly at this exposure; the side vents carry the ventilation critical.
corrections: Surface pass: decide the display's on-state content honestly (structure/UI chrome, no fabricated numbers), and add contrast to the front-grille recesses.
Keep rear receptacles as an OPEN ITEM.

mechanical.notes: Console clean (0/0) on default and power=off. 7/7 spec materials map 1:1 (orchestrator-verified: vent_cavity now present in the spec, lcd_glass roughness reconciled to 0.05). Budget unchanged (42/250 draws, 1144/400000 tris — materials add no geometry). The traceability sweep now ASSERTS 'declared but not rendered' rather than printing it (the Stratix lesson, where that line was a console.log and the check exited green while naming a real defect).

notes: Inline orchestrator judgment. Both material asks delivered WITH measurement, not by feel: the LCD glass read comes from a sharp environment reflection on a near-black base (envMap up, roughness held to spec), and the vent-recess contrast was measured to come from the louvre blade (12.1x), not the throat-vs-bezel pair that no albedo can separate — then asserted. The most useful part of the pass was the builder's own error, surfaced not buried: vent_cavity lived in CODE with no spec entry for a whole pass (the exact drift he caught twice on the Stratix, committed here precisely by skipping the traceability sweep), plus a 0.04-vs-0.05 lcd_glass roughness drift reconciled toward the contract. Both are now caught by an ASSERTING sweep. Cleared to the surface pass; two honest open items carried (rear receptacles, display on-state).
